tasks.subject: Task 1: Update CSS for 3-column grid
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Adjust `.body-parts-grid` to use a fixed 3-column layout and add the section heading + last-card centering rules.

**Files:**
- Modify: `docs/custom_css/extra.css:111-116`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `.body-parts-grid` uses `repeat(3, 1fr)` columns
- [ ] `.body-part-card.last` sets `grid-column: 2`
- [ ] `.body-parts-section-heading` style exists

**Verify:** `grep -n "repeat(3, 1fr)\|body-part-card.last\|body-parts-section-heading" docs/custom_css/extra.css` → 3 matches

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/custom_css/extra.css"], "verifyCommand": "grep -n 'repeat(3, 1fr)\\|body-part-card.last\\|body-parts-section-heading' docs/custom_css/extra.css", "acceptanceCriteria": [".body-parts-grid uses repeat(3, 1fr)", ".body-part-card.last sets grid-column: 2", ".body-parts-section-heading style exists"]}
```
